Just don't get too rowdy, or you may find yourself on the receiving end of Varesh's famed law and order. }} '''Kodonur Crossroads''' is a Kournan outpost relatively well-outfitted with merchants and traders. It is the main trading center of Kourna. ==Getting there== The [[primary quest]] [[Centaur Blackmail]] leads to this outpost. Alternatively, travel to the southeastern corner of [[Jahai Bluffs]]. {{verify}} You will still need to complete the aforementioned quest in order to start the [[Kodonur Crossroads|associated mission]]. ==Exits== *[[Dejarin Estate]] (south) *[[Jahai Bluffs]] (northwest) *[[The Floodplain of Mahnkelon]] (northeast) ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Services==== =====Collectors and crafters===== *{{x}} 10 [[Ajambo]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Sentient Lodestone]]s) *{{x}} 20 [[Hadusi]] ([[weaponsmith]]) =====Henchmen===== :''(all level 20)'' *{{w}} [[Devona]] (Fighter) *{{r}} [[Aidan]] (Archer) *{{mo}} [[Kihm]] (Healer) *{{mo}} [[Mhenlo]] (Healer) *{{n}} [[Eve]] (Blood) *{{me}} [[Odurra]] (Domination) *{{e}} [[Cynn]] (Fire) *{{e}} [[Herta]] (Earth) *{{p}} [[Sogolon]] (Motivation) *{{d}} [[Gehraz]] (Holy) =====Merchants and Traders===== *{{x}} 20 [[Koulaba]] ([[merchant]]) *{{x}} 20 [[Nehbusa]] ([[material trader]]) *{{x}} 20 [[Orram]] ([[rare material trader]]) =====Other services===== *{{x}} 15 [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage upgrades]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) ====Other allies==== *{{x}} 20 [[Estate Guard Rikesh]] (mission starter) *{{x}} 20 [[Korsu]] (mission briefing) *{{x}} 10 [[Kournan Peasant]]s *{{x}} 2 [[Kournan Child]]ren ==Notes== {{gw2w|Kodonur Crossing}} *The [[world map]] actually marks this location with the icon for an outpost upon initial arrival.
